milestones.title: M0 — Physical baseline
milestones.description: Retrospective builder-confirmed assembly, upload, motor and serial exercises. Raw artifact gaps remain separate tasks.

milestones.title: M1 — Reproducible baseline
milestones.description: Recover exact working firmware, wiring, settings, historical source and demo evidence.

milestones.title: M2 — Pi integration
milestones.description: USB discovery, bounded serial bridge and independent motor-side stop/fault evidence.

milestones.title: M3 — Mechanical protection
milestones.description: Measured enclosure design, small fit coupon and removable serviceable body.

milestones.title: M4 — Operations telemetry
milestones.description: Managed Pi service, logs and real telemetry-only Command City integration.

milestones.title: M5 — Supervised phone control
milestones.description: Authenticated local UI through one validated controller with expiry and disconnect handling.

milestones.title: M6 — Secure missions
milestones.description: Validated sensors, bounded mission state and deterministic robot policy experiments.
